GAPS E6 lists no difference for this row ('None once wired'), so difference 10 of the log is not allowed. A tool that went through several anvil enchantings cannot be repaired.

Or ask the coordinator to accept the difference in GAPS E6.

findings.what: remove_totem empties the extra slot with native_take_items, which takes from the main hand first and not from the given slot. If the held totem is the one that must stay (first in order) and a plain extra sits in another slot, the held totem vanishes and the extra stays. The count is right (one totem) but the player loses the totem in his hand. Java empties exactly the extra slot.

evidence.host: docs/native-mods.md:3453 `native_take_items(item, count)` (the main hand first, then as `Inventory.add` orders slots),

findings.fix: Always empty the given slot through native_carried_stack (count 0, cleaned the next inventory tick), or take items only when the slot is the main hand. The log says the zero count is cleaned at the next tick, so it is safe for plain stacks too.
findings.note: Evidence holds (native_server.rs:1059-1070: take_items takes the selected slot first). remove_totem now uses take_items only when the slot is the selected hotbar slot (NativeServerPlayer.selected_slot) and the stack is plain; any other slot gets a count of 0 (native_hooks.rs:10394-10398), so only the extra slot empties. Not run in the game: log item 11.

findings.what: A hopper never picks up a Totem of Eternity from the ground, even into an empty hopper. Java's canPlaceItem accepts the first totem and refuses only the second. The log lists it (difference 8) but GAPS T13 does not allow a blanket refusal: it says to cancel the hook, with no change of rule. Hopper-based totem collection and any hopper fed by a drop is blocked.
findings.fix: Ask the coordinator to accept the difference in GAPS T13 (the hook has no Game and no hopper reader), or read the hopper through a pending helper when one exists.
findings.note: Evidence holds (bmh_totem.rs on_hopper_pickup_item; game.rs:1299 calls the hook with the level and the position only). The hook has no Game and no helper reads the hopper, so the first totem cannot be told from the second. Needs a GAPS T13 decision by the coordinator, or a Horizon helper that reads a container from this hook. Log difference 8.
